title: Team work history
readOnlySupervisor: Closed Voice work handled by your team, counted by the Agent's team when they answered. Read-only.
readOnlyAdmin: Closed Voice work of every team, counted by the Agent's team when they answered. Read-only.
evidenceNote: Work without team evidence at answer time (for example before this was enabled) is not shown here.
empty: This team has no closed Voice work yet
unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
forbidden: This account cannot view team history. It needs to be a Supervisor with a team, or an Admin.
notFound: This work or team was not found, or you cannot open it
noNote: Earlier work has no note; none was created afterwards
legacy: Earlier work before notes were recorded

summary.title: Team summary
summary.talkBasis: From {{count}} items with answer and hang-up times
summary.emptyPeriod: No Voice work closed in this period
summary.emptyFiltered: No work matches this filter in this period
summary.emptyPeriodChannels: No work closed in this period

readOnlySupervisorChannels: Closed work (calls and chats) handled by your team, counted by the Agent's team when the work was accepted. Read-only.
readOnlyAdminChannels: Closed work (calls and chats) of every team, counted by the Agent's team when the work was accepted. Read-only.
evidenceNoteChannels: Work without team evidence when the work was accepted (for example before this was enabled) is not shown here.
emptyChannels: This team has no closed work yet
